_comment: OpenAI Responses API configuration for the WinWin hotel-search assistant. The Assistants API is deprecated (sunset 2026), so this uses the Responses API; the same prompt + tools can be stored as a reusable Prompt object in the OpenAI dashboard and referenced by id/version. Variant B is used for the A/B test.

A._why: Reasoning model: better at multi-constraint extraction, date arithmetic and conflict detection; low effort keeps p95 latency ~2-3 s. Reasoning models ignore temperature/top_p.

B._why: Non-reasoning baseline: cheaper and faster; low temperature because extraction must be deterministic, not creative.

common.conversation_memory: Backend keeps the conversation (last 12 turns) and ALWAYS injects current_state; the model never relies on memory alone for the filter state.

tools.name: search_filter_catalog
tools.description: Semantic + synonym search over the 1000+ hotel filter catalog. Use it to find filter ids for user phrases that are not in top_filters. Batch all phrases of the turn in one call.

phrase.description: User wording, e.g. 'reading light on both sides of the bed'.

category_hint.description: Optional catalog category to narrow results, e.g. 'beds', 'bathroom', 'language'.

tools.name: update_search
tools.description: Apply a PATCH to the current hotel search state. Backend validates it, resolves conflicts, and returns the normalised state, issues, missing required slots, offer_count, relaxations and facets.

reset.description: true = start from an empty state (new trip or explicit reset).

name.description: As the user named it, e.g. 'Haarlem'.

ambiguous_with.description: Other places with the same name when ambiguous; empty otherwise.

window_start.description: For vague dates: earliest possible check-in.

window_end.description: For vague dates: latest possible check-out.

nights.description: Stay length if known without exact dates ('a week in May' = 7).

assumption.description: Human-readable assumption, e.g. 'Assumed Aug 2027 because Aug 2026 is past'.

children_ages.description: One entry per child. Use -1 for a child whose age is unknown (backend will ask).

op.description: add = set/overwrite; remove = delete from state.

filter_id.description: Exact id from top_filters or search_filter_catalog.

bool_value.description: Boolean filters only. false = must NOT have.

min.description: Range filters only, in the filter unit.

source_quote.description: The user's words that triggered this operation (for audit, UI tooltips and evals).

unmapped_preferences.description: Wishes with no matching filter; used for review-based semantic ranking.

currency.description: ISO 4217 if the user named a currency, else null (use locale default).

user_language.description: BCP-47 language of the user's message, e.g. 'en', 'nl'.

message.description: Text shown in the chat bubble (user's language, 2-5 sentences).

quick_replies.description: One-tap answers for the follow-up question.
